package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for string_format_for_error_wrap: `fmt.Errorf("failed: %s", err.Error())` where `%s` on `err.Error()` is used instead of `%w` on `err`
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.

func scenario647Positive(userID int) error {
	err := fetchUser(userID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch user %d: %s", userID, err.Error())
	}
	return nil
}

func fetchUser(id int) error {
	return errors.New("user not found")
}
